rationale: C19 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It is an earlier order with the same distinctive title formula and the same legal mechanism of specifying statutes inapplicable to a defined program. All three statutes listed in the child appear together in C19, in the same relative order and with nearly identical citations and wording. C15 is a more remote predecessor using the same exemption machinery and two of the same statutes, while C08 has only a weaker connection through an escapee-related program and enumerated statutory exemptions.
